results.sql:
WITH num AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND upper(p.drug_name) = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory = ANY(%s)
), den AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value

WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory = ANY(%s) AND p.market_subcategory = ANY(%s)
)
SELECT n.value AS numerator, d.value AS denominator,
       n.value / NULLIF(d.value, 0) AS value
FROM num n CROSS JOIN den d

results.question: Show me the monthly volume trend for Gemtara over the last six months
results.reason: plan matches and the request succeeded
results.sql:
WITH pac_periods AS (
  SELECT c.period_mo AS label, min(c.wk_offset) AS newest, count(*) AS weeks,
         min(CASE WHEN %s = ANY(c.sources) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS covered
  FROM app_ref.calendar c
  GROUP BY c.period_mo), pac_numbered AS (
  SELECT label, covered, weeks,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY newest DESC) AS pos
  FROM pac_periods), pac_requested AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.period_mo AS label FROM app_ref.calendar c
  WHERE c.mo_offset = ANY(%s)), pac_span AS (
  SELECT min(n.pos) - %s AS lo, max(n.pos) AS hi
  FROM pac_numbered n JOIN pac_requested r ON r.label = n.label), pac_spine AS (
  SELECT n.label, n.covered, n.weeks, n.pos,
         n.label IN (SELECT label FROM pac_requested) AS requested
  FROM pac_numbered n CROSS JOIN pac_span sp
  WHERE n.pos BETWEEN sp.lo AND sp.hi), pac_series AS (
SELECT s.period_mo AS dim0_id, s.period_mo AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.period_mo IN (SELECT label FROM pac_spine) AND upper(p.drug_name) = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY s.period_mo, s.period_mo
), pac_dense AS (
  SELECT sp.label AS dim0_id, sp.label AS dim0_label, sp.pos, sp.requested, sp.weeks,
         CASE WHEN sp.covered THEN COALESCE(se.value, 0) END AS value
  FROM pac_spine sp
  LEFT JOIN pac_series se ON se.dim0_id = sp.label)
SELECT dim0_id, dim0_label, value
FROM pac_dense WHERE requested
ORDER BY dim0_id ASC
LIMIT 5001

plan.interpretation: Growth of last_quarter (offsets 1,2,3) versus r6m_prior (offsets 3,4,5), the business R6M comparison window for the prior quarter. Ranked by highest growth.

results.sql:
WITH cur AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
), pri AS (
SELECT COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name) AS dim0_label, SUM(s.pack_units) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN organizations o ON o.org_id = s.org_id
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s)
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_id, o.org_id), COALESCE(o.grandparent_org_name, o.org_name)
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.dim0_id, p.dim0_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(c.dim0_label, p.dim0_label) AS dim0_label, c.value AS current_value, p.value AS prior_value,
       (c.value - p.value) / NULLIF(p.value, 0) AS value
FROM cur c FULL OUTER JOIN pri p ON COALESCE(c.dim0_id::text, %s) = COALESCE(p.dim0_id::text, %s)

)
SELECT n.dim0_id AS dim0_id, n.dim0_label AS dim0_label,
       n.value AS numerator, d.value AS denominator,
       n.value / NULLIF(d.value, 0) AS value
FROM num n LEFT JOIN den d ON COALESCE(n.jk0::text, %s) = COALESCE(d.jk0::text, %s)
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.dim0_id, p.dim0_id) AS dim0_id, COALESCE(c.dim0_label, p.dim0_label) AS dim0_label, c.value AS current_value, p.value AS prior_value,
       (c.value - p.value) * 100.0 AS value
FROM cur c FULL OUTER JOIN pri p ON COALESCE(c.dim0_id::text, %s) = COALESCE(p.dim0_id::text, %s)
ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

results.question: What is the generic share in the Platinum Compounds market?

plan.interpretation: Generic share is the proportion of reported market volume in the Platinum Compounds market category held by products classified as generic, expressed as a ratio.

results.sql:
WITH num AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
LEFT JOIN app_ref.product_classification c ON c.ndc = p.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND c.classification = ANY(%s)
), den AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s)
), unk AS (
SELECT SUM(s.pack_units * p.unit_conversion_factor) AS value
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.ndc = s.ndc
LEFT JOIN app_ref.product_classification c ON c.ndc = p.ndc
WHERE s.data_source = ANY(%s) AND s.mo_offset = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND p.market_category = ANY(%s) AND c.classification = 'unknown'
)
SELECT n.value AS numerator, d.value AS denominator,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.value, 0) < d.value
            THEN COALESCE(n.value, 0) / NULLIF(d.value, 0) END AS value,
       COALESCE(u.value, 0) AS unclassified,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.value, 0) < d.value
            THEN (COALESCE(n.value, 0) + COALESCE(u.value, 0)) / NULLIF(d.value, 0) END AS value_upper
FROM num n CROSS JOIN den d
CROSS JOIN unk u
